title: Venue preset
description: One venue preset or template family (presets/<name>.jsonc), and the TeX base set (presets/tex-base.jsonc). A paper's paperlint.json names one with "extends"; a preset may extend another. `format` and `rules` are read by paperlint's pdf/* venue rules and its lint config (src/venue-rules.ts, src/presets.ts); `tex` by `paperlint toolchain` and `paperlint build`.

extends.description: The preset this one builds on: `paperlint:<name>` (shipped) or a path starting with ./ or ../, relative to this file.

name.description: A display name for messages; the file name otherwise.

template.description: The \documentclass the venue's template uses: a whole line, `\documentclass[conference,compsoc]{IEEEtran}`, or a bare class name. `tex/template` requires a paper's class to be this one and to carry every option named here.

blind.description: The venue reviews double-blind: its call says submissions must be anonymized. Read by `anonymity/identity`, which then requires the paper's `identity` and finds none of it in the PDF. Set only where the venue says so, with the quote. A child's value replaces its parent's.

aliases.description: Other names the venue goes by in a paper's text — its acronym, its parent conference (`["AISec", "ACM CCS"]`). Read by `tex/venue-leftover`: a paper that extends another venue and says one of these is flagged. Matched as whole words, case-sensitive. Collected along the `extends` chain, with `name`.

required_sections.description: Sections the venue requires, read by `tex/required-section`. Each is a `\section` or `\section*` whose title equals `title` once whitespace is collapsed. `position: "last"`: after every section of the body (the ones before the appendix and the bibliography); it may stand after the bibliography. A child preset's list replaces its parent's.

format.description: What the venue's call for papers sets. Every key is optional; a child preset's key replaces its parent's, and a child's kind replaces that kind.

body_ends_at.description: How `format/page-limit` counts body pages. Absent: banal's body count (every page holding non-bibliography text). `references`: the pages up to where the body ends — at the references or the appendix, whichever comes first, found by hyperref's anchors and then the heading line — with that page counted when body text stands above the heading on it; for a venue whose limit excludes references and appendices (and what follows them, such as statements).

rules.description: Rules the venue implies, rule id → ESLint entry (a severity, or [severity, options]). Applied to every paper that extends this preset, before the paper's own rules.

ctanName.description: A package name as tlmgr knows it (CTAN / TeX Live), not a distribution package name.

tex.description: The TeX Live packages this template needs. Each package maps to the files that PROVE it is present: `kpsewhich` must find every one after an install, or the install failed and says which package.

tools.description: Packages that ship a PROGRAM rather than a file LaTeX loads. Proved by an executable of that name in TeX Live's bin directory, not by kpsewhich.
